judge.rationale: The candidate correctly updates `chatOrchestrator.ts` to wrap non-`Error` rejections in an `Error` with `cause` set to the original value, while re-throwing the original rejection to the caller. It also properly updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the line-number references in the other spec files. However, the candidate misses part of the second acceptance criterion: it never tests rejecting with `undefined`, nor does its plain-object acceptance test assert that `error.cause` equals the original object. Additionally, the candidate leaves behind `.lore/dod.md` and splits tests into a separate `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file (with an uncommented `eslint-disable-next-line` directive), whereas the reference keeps all tests cleanly in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and uses `JSON.stringify` for a more descriptive error message on objects rather than `String(reason)` (`"[object Object]"`).
